reason: Money is tight after daycare went up, and $59 a month is a fixed cost I would have to be sure I'd use. It's not open yet, and my baby is the smallest one there, so I'd rather wait and see.
objection: Will bigger kids be running wild around my baby? Unlimited play for kids up to 5 mixed with babies sounds like my 8-month-old gets flattened, and I'd be paying $59 to hover over her.
would_change_my_mind: A separate baby/toddler area or set baby-only hours, plus a free trial visit or a pay-per-visit option so I'm not locked into a monthly fee.
